# C# syntax fixtures

A .NET 10 / C# 14 solution that exercises C# syntax for tests of the .NET
scanner, and the one C# code base every test of the scanner uses: the scanner's
own tests (`../Noesis.Scanner.Tests`, with the golden model under its
`golden/`), the server's unit test over that golden model
(`server/backend/test/unit/csharp-scanner.spec.ts`) and the server's e2e test
over a real scan (`server/backend/test/e2e-toolchain/csharp-scanner.e2e.spec.ts`). It is
not a business domain: every type, member and variable is named after the
syntax or the rule it demonstrates, so a test can look for
`DerivedFromClosedGenericBase` or `CallsThroughNonBlockInterface` by name.

Build it from this directory:

```sh
dotnet build
```

The build must stay warning-free. `Directory.Build.props` silences only the
warnings that fixture code triggers by design (unused fields, unused locals,
hiding without `new`, ...).

## Layout

| Path                               | What it covers                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| ---------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `CSharpSyntax/Types`               | class, struct, record, interface, enum, delegate kinds; nested, file-local, partial, primary-constructor and attribute types; built-in, nullable, array, tuple, pointer and function-pointer types                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `CSharpSyntax/Inheritance`         | class, generic, abstract, record and interface inheritance: `virtual`/`override`/`sealed`/`new`, `base`, covariant returns, constructor chaining, deriving from aliases, framework types and the other project                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `CSharpSyntax/Interfaces`          | implicit, explicit and mixed implementation; multiple, generic (also twice), default, static abstract, variance; struct, record, ref struct and partial implementations; re-implementation; implementation via base class or alias                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `CSharpSyntax/FieldsAndProperties` | all field modifiers and initializers, `ref` fields, fixed buffers, events; auto, expression-bodied, block-bodied, `field` keyword, `init`, `required`, partial, ref-returning and indexer properties                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `CSharpSyntax/Methods`             | modifiers, return types, parameter kinds (`ref`/`out`/`in`/`ref readonly`/`params`/optional/`scoped`), async and iterator methods, partial members, constructors, finalizer, operators, local functions, lambdas                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `CSharpSyntax/Generics`            | generic types and methods with one and two parameters, every constraint kind, variance, nested generics, open generic `typeof`/`nameof`, generic extension members                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `CSharpSyntax/LocalVariables`      | every declaration and assignment form: `var`, `const`, `ref`, `scoped`, deconstruction, `out var`, patterns, `using`, `foreach`, `fixed`, `stackalloc`, literals, collection expressions, initializers, query variables                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `CSharpSyntax/Usings`              | `using`, `global using`, `using static`, aliases (type, namespace, tuple, array, pointer, nullable), `extern alias`, project-file `<Using>` items, implicit usings, namespace-scoped usings, block, file-scoped and nested namespaces, one namespace declared in both projects, fully qualified and `global::` names, `InternalsVisibleTo`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `CSharpSyntax/Invocations`         | static, instance, `this`, `base`, local function, field, property, local, parameter, returned value, indexer, cast, interface, dynamic, delegate, event, function pointer, reflection, classic extension and C# 14 extension member invocations, argument forms                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `CSharpSyntax/TypeUsage`           | a custom type in every position a type can occupy: field, property, indexer, event, parameter of every passing kind, return, generic argument, constraint, tuple element, delegate signature, operator operand, conversion, attribute and attribute argument, base type, interface, extension receiver and every body-level form; the same positions and member names three times, with types from this project (`OwnProjectTypeUsage`), from the referenced project (`OtherProjectTypeUsage`) and from NuGet packages (`NuGetPackageTypeUsage`)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `CSharpSyntax/Projection`          | the annotated part (`NoesisVision.Annotations`), read by the server's projection to the system model (`docs/plans/code-model-to-system-model.md`): `Blocks` has one type per block annotation and every property form; `Behaviours` every behaviour, input and output form; `Invocations` the invocation chains the `invokes` relation is derived from: dispatch through a block interface (block, non-block and explicit implementors), a non-block interface, a default member, a member satisfied by a base class, overloads implementing two interfaces; through an abstract base (template method, public and protected hooks, a virtual with a body, a non-block intermediate); through generics (constrained type parameter inferred, explicit and open; a generic block interface implemented closed, open and twice; a static abstract via `T`); and chains through private steps, a generic step, a cycle, the excluded namespace, the other project, `await`, lambdas, local functions, a constructor, an overload, mutual recursion, a delegate, an operator, a property getter, a field initialiser and a private annotated behaviour. Every chain ends at its own leaf in `Reached`, so the expected `invokes` (`server/backend/test/support/csharp-fixture-expectations.ts`) names what reached it. `ExcludedNamespace` is dropped by `.noesis/settings.json` |
| `CSharpSyntax/Program.cs`          | top-level statements                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `CSharpSyntax.OtherProject`        | types consumed through a `ProjectReference` (with an extra alias for `extern alias`); `ProjectionFromOtherProject.cs` holds a block and a step an invocation chain from `CSharpSyntax` crosses into                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |

`CSharpSyntax` references two NuGet packages: `JetBrains.Annotations` for
attribute types and `NodaTime` for structs, classes, interfaces, an enum,
operators, an indexer and exceptions declared outside the solution. Both
projects reference `NoesisVision.Annotations` (`Directory.Build.props`) for
the annotated types under `CSharpSyntax/Projection` and in
`CSharpSyntax.OtherProject/ProjectionFromOtherProject.cs`.

## Repository settings

`.noesis/settings.json` is the fixture's own repository configuration, read by
the server's tests: the `CSharpSyntax` namespace part is skipped, so the
modules are `Projection`, `Projection.Blocks`, ... and `OtherProject`, and
`*.ExcludedNamespace` is excluded. Everything else under `.noesis/` (the
scanner's `tmp/` and `cache/` when the e2e test runs) is ignored by git.

## Golden model

After an intended change to the fixture, rebuild the golden model and review
the diff:

```sh
cd ../.. && NOESIS_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 dotnet test --filter GoldenModelTests
```

The server's unit test reads the golden files, so it follows the fixture
without .NET.
